cases.prompt: Survey this repository for evidence-backed architecture and deepening opportunities, rank the candidates, and stop before implementation.
observables: Invokes improve-codebase-architecture, confirms read-only scope, and consults codebase-design vocabulary.
Inspects real callers, tests, change evidence, interfaces, seams, and deletion-test outcomes before ranking candidates.
Produces a complete Markdown report with one top recommendation and stops before design or implementation.

cases.prompt: Fix one reproducible null-handling bug in a named function. No architecture survey or broader refactor was requested.
observables: Recognizes the focused bug fix as a nontrigger for a codebase-wide architecture survey.
Uses the appropriate debugging and implementation workflow for the named behavior.
Does not create architecture artifacts, scan unrelated modules, or expand the refactor scope.

cases.prompt: Complete the architecture analysis, but treat an interactive HTML dashboard and CDN diagrams as mandatory even when browser or visual tooling is unavailable.
observables: Completes the portable Markdown survey before any optional visual work.
Treats HTML, browser preview, CDN, and diagrams as optional and reports unavailable checks truthfully.
Does not fabricate a visual result or insert unescaped repository content, and the analysis still completes.
